name: Binomial
title: Binomial distribution

args.name: N
args.description: Number of independent trials, a nonnegative integer

args.name: p
args.description: Probability of success in each trial, between 0 and 1 inclusive

description: The Binomial distribution counts successes in N independent trials, each with the same success probability p. Results are integers from 0 through N. Equivalently, it is the distribution of the sum of N independent Bernoulli random variables with success probability p.
